    Contour functions and their cohomological vanishing target #

    Restrict raw scalar assignments on parallel path pairs to the subgroup satisfying the contour-function laws: transitivity through parallel paths and invariance under common path whiskers. The arrow-weight coboundary lands in this subgroup. Surjectivity onto it is the precise formal target of Roiter's contour-cohomology vanishing theorem.

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.PathContourRelation (Q : Type v) [Quiver Q] :
    Type (max v w)

    A symmetric, transitive relation on parallel quiver paths. It is allowed to be non-reflexive: in ray-category applications related p p expresses that p has nonzero image.

    • related {i j : Q} : Quiver.Path i j → Quiver.Path i j → Prop
    • symm' {i j : Q} {p q : Quiver.Path i j} : self.related p q → self.related q p
    • trans' {i j : Q} {p q r : Quiver.Path i j} : self.related p q → self.related q r → self.related p r
